language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language of the app. Follows the system by default

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Light, dark, or follow the system appearance

theme.title: Color theme
theme.description: Hues for surfaces, text and accents. Every theme follows the appearance above, so it has a light and a dark rendition.

futureos.name: FutureOS
futureos.description: The default: cool neutral greys with a single blue accent.

catppuccin.description: Pastel surfaces with a blue accent.

vesper.name: Vesper

fontSize.title: Font size
fontSize.description: Adjust the size of text without changing the layout

description.default: A finished reply shows its final answer, with the reasoning, tool calls and notes that produced it folded into one row you can open. Work is still shown while it streams.
description.detailed: A finished reply keeps everything: its reasoning, tool calls and notes stay in place, interleaved with the answer in the order they happened.

approvalTier.title: Approval mode
approvalTier.linuxWriteOnly: Upgrade system Bubblewrap and restart FutureOS to enable full sandbox protection.

description.manual: File access follows approval rules; allowlisted read-only commands run automatically, other commands ask. No OS sandbox.
description.sandbox: Commands run in the macOS sandbox and ask for approval when needed.
description.sandboxWindows: Commands run with Windows write protection and ask for approval when needed.
description.sandboxLinux: Commands run in the Linux sandbox and ask for approval when needed.
description.off: No prompts, no sandbox — every command runs with full access to this machine.
description.auto: Automatically reviews actions with sandbox protection.

approvalTier.fallbackNotice: Sandbox protection is unavailable (diagnostic: {{code}}). Switched to Manual mode: approved or allowlisted commands run without an OS sandbox.

reasons.binaryMissing: Bubblewrap is not installed. Install Bubblewrap, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.pathRejected: No trusted system Bubblewrap was found. Check PATH and confirm the bwrap file is owned by root, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.binaryInvalid: System Bubblewrap is not a valid executable. Reinstall it or repair its permissions, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.versionUnreadable: The Bubblewrap version could not be recognized. Reinstall or upgrade Bubblewrap, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.versionTooOld: This Bubblewrap package cannot provide the required protection. Upgrade it, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.requiredFeatureMissing: This Bubblewrap package lacks features required by FutureOS. Upgrade or replace the system package, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.userNamespaceDisabled: Unprivileged user namespaces are disabled. Enable them, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.procMountRestricted: The system does not allow the sandbox to mount a private /proc. Adjust the system or container policy, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.probeTimeout: Bubblewrap detection timed out. Check the system, then restart FutureOS and try again. ({{code}})
reasons.probeFailed: The Bubblewrap sandbox check failed. Run future doctor for details, fix the issue, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.binaryIdentityChanged: The Bubblewrap file changed after detection. Verify the system package, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.probeTransportError: FutureOS could not contact the Agent to check the Linux sandbox. Try again later or restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.unknown: The Linux sandbox is unavailable. Run future doctor for details, fix the issue, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})

approvalTier.autoUnavailable: The sandbox is unavailable on this host. Requests use manual review; the automatic setting is retained.

autoUpgradeSkills.title: Auto-upgrade skills
autoUpgradeSkills.description: Silently upgrade installed skills to their latest version each time the app opens

skillRecommend.title: Skill recommendations
skillRecommend.description: When you send a message, suggest at most one skill you don't have installed yet. Off by default.

autoTitleFirstTurn.title: Generate a title after the first answer
autoTitleFirstTurn.description: Generate and save a title after a new conversation’s first successful answer, using the same generator as the rename dialog. Later answers do not trigger it. Conversation context is not compacted. On by default.

bellOnComplete.title: Completion bell
bellOnComplete.description: Play a sound and attract the window's attention when an agent finishes

update.maintenanceUnavailable: We can’t confirm the update status right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
update.awaitingResult: Updating FutureOS. This may take a moment.
update.title: Check for updates
update.manualOnly: Download the latest version to update FutureOS.
update.noAsset: An installer isn’t available for this device yet. Please try again later.
update.downloadFailed: The download page couldn’t be opened. Check your connection and try again.
update.checkFailed: Couldn’t check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
update.installFailed: The update couldn’t be completed. Please try again later, or download the installer.
update.restored: The update couldn’t be completed. Your previous version has been restored.
update.repairRequired: The update couldn’t be completed. Download the installer, reinstall FutureOS, then open it again.
update.cleanupFailed: FutureOS couldn’t finish preparing for the update. Close and reopen FutureOS, then try again. If it won’t open, download the installer to reinstall it.
update.restartFailed: Couldn’t restart automatically. Close and reopen FutureOS. If it won’t open, download the installer to reinstall it.
update.repairFailed: Couldn’t confirm your reinstallation. Please reopen FutureOS after the installer finishes.
update.installConfirmation: Updating will interrupt any work still in progress. Update now, or keep working and update later.
update.repairConfirmation: Continue only after the installer has finished. If it hasn’t, finish reinstalling FutureOS first.

models.noModels: No models loaded from the Agent. Make sure it's running and signed in.

providers.modelsUpdateFailed: Couldn't update the Future model list. Check your network connection and sign-in status, then try again.
providers.keyDialogDescription: The key is stored only on this computer and used to connect to the model service.
providers.keySaved: Saved the {{provider}} key. It takes effect immediately.
providers.baseUrlDialogDescription: This provider's Base URL is a placeholder — replace it with your own (e.g. your Azure resource name).
providers.apiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current key

customProvider.apiKeyLabelEditing: API key (leave blank to keep current)
customProvider.modelNamePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the model ID
customProvider.reasoningDescription: Allow thinking controls to be sent to this model. Turn off if the API does not support them.
customProvider.priceHint: Leave a price at 0 to skip it. Prices only affect the amount shown for models whose provider does not report its own billing (everything except Future).

errors.idPattern: Provider ID may only contain lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_'.

errors.baseUrlInvalid: Base URL must be a valid http/https address.
errors.namePattern: Provider name may only contain letters, digits, spaces and _.()-; Chinese / emoji / full-width characters are not supported.
errors.nameExists: That provider name already exists, please choose another.

errors.maxTokensExceedContext: Maximum output tokens for model "{{id}}" cannot exceed its context window.

errors.modelsMax: The number of models cannot exceed {{max}}.

futureLogin.title: Connect FutureOS
futureLogin.description: The authorization page should have opened in your browser. If it didn't, copy the link to open it manually.
futureLogin.waiting: Once you finish signing in and authorizing in your browser, the connection completes automatically here…
futureLogin.expired: The authorization code has expired, please try again.
futureLogin.unavailable: The server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
futureLogin.invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid response. Please try again.

reset.switchEnvironmentDescription: Switch the sign-in and API endpoints between production and test. Switching clears the current sign-in and restarts the app automatically; you'll need to sign in again in the new environment.
reset.writeProtectionDescription: Remove folder permissions added by FutureOS for Windows write protection. No files are deleted. If a task is running, wait for it to finish before resetting.
reset.writeProtectionFailed: Reset is not available right now. Wait for running tasks to finish, then try again.
reset.clearDataDescription: Clear the GUI local database and temporary workspace (chats, background programs, review records, etc.); the app restarts automatically when done. Sign-in and provider settings are unaffected. This action cannot be undone.
reset.confirmClear: Clear all local data and restart?

about.followDescription: Follow {{name}} on WeChat for release notes, feature guides and research tips.
about.followHint: Scan the QR code with WeChat, or search for “{{name}}” in WeChat.
about.followQrAlt: WeChat QR code for the {{name}} official account

autoResumeInterrupted.title: Continue interrupted conversations
autoResumeInterrupted.description: Closing FutureOS stops the conversations that were running (the agent runs inside the app). When on, the next launch continues them by itself; when off, they stay interrupted until you continue them.
